Applicant :- Mo. Vahid
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Arti Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Smt. Arti Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Statendra Srivastava, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.340 of 2024 under Sections 376, 323, 506 I.P.C. registered at Police Station- Gosaiganj, District- Sultanpur.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 30.08.2024 against the applicant, Raees and Shahid, stating that the informant had got married to co-accused Raees on 16.12.2021 and the applicant had mediated settlement of the marriage.
The informant's husband had given her Talak on phone due to which she was very disturbed.
Co-accused Shahid again tried to mediate in the dispute between the informant and her husband and when her husband did not listen to him, Shahid asked her to stay at his place for sometime.
Taking advantage of the informant's situation, Shahid (who is the applicant's father) raped her during night.
She told about the incident to the applicant in the morning whereupon both the persons beaten her up and turned her out of their house.

1 4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she alleged that Shahid used to commit misdeed against her every night and thereafter he asked his son (the applicant) that he would get him married to the informant and thereafter Vahid also started making physical relations with her due to which she got pregnant.
The applicant forcibly administered some medicine due to which she suffered miscarriage.

A similar statement was given by the victim while recording her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
5.
The medico-legal examination report of the victim does not contain any finding which may support the allegations levelled in the F.I.R. or in the statements of the informant.

6. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is a young man aged 21 years having no criminal history and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

7. The applicant had filed Crl. Misc. Writ Petition No.7497 of 2024 and by means of an order dated 03.10.2024, a Division Bench of this Court had stayed the arrest of the petitioner till filing of charge-sheet.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Writ Petition No.7497 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application and on the basis of written instructions, he has submitted that allegations have been established during investigation and a charge-sheet has been submitted on 22.10.2024.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that informant herself has lodged the FIR in which she has not levelled allegation of commission of rape against the applicant and this allegation has been levelled subsequently; it is extremely strange that the informant has alleged in her statement that she had taken shelter in the house of the applicant and the applicant and his father both used to rape her, which allegation is not supported by the findings of the medico-legal examination report and that the applicant is a young man aged 21 years having no criminal history, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in the aforesaid crime.
